answer: Run synchronized spot checks. At an unannounced moment picked by the public beacon, every identity gets a fresh task due within ninety seconds. An honest agent only needs capacity for itself, but a farm of N fakes can't time-share one model across its accounts; it must keep N parallel pipelines ready at once, so its standing bill grows linearly with N. No ivory-tower trust is needed: graders bridge each reply to a public grade, and passed checks grow like a trellis into the record that unlocks payouts.
